display.purpose: Screen-level titles, species hero names, app bar. Mud Track only.

headline.purpose: Sub-section headers within screens. Bitter slab serif.

title.purpose: Card primary labels, list row headers. Bitter.

body.purpose: Content blocks, species summaries, regulation notes. Inter.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows and count chips. Inter uppercase, wide tracking. Used deliberately, not reflexively.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Ambient depth on card theme. Invisible at dark ambient; disambiguation on bright displays only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transitions. Material standard easing.

motion.name: ease-decel
motion.purpose: Elements entering the screen (sheet slide-up, panel open).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Pine fill, forest text. Tactile and grounded — no hover animation, color-only state change.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4c9a5f; color: #0b120c; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2f7042; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1b4332; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c9a5f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Species Chip
components.description: Tappable chip showing a colored species dot and name. Water-context UI only.
components.css: .ds-chip-species { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #1a2a1c; color: #9db3a0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #24382a; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-chip-species:hover { border-color: #4c9a5f; background: rgba(76,154,95,0.1); color: #ecf2ea; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Filter Chip (active)
components.description: Category filter pill in its selected state. Pine tint fill, pine border.
components.css: .ds-chip-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #1a2a1c; color: #5c7260; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #24382a; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-chip-filter--active { background: rgba(76,154,95,0.15); color: #4c9a5f; border-color: #4c9a5f; } .ds-chip-filter:hover { border-color: #4c9a5f; color: #4c9a5f; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standard content tile. Forest fill, topo border, 16px radius. No elevation animation.
components.html:
Sixmile Lake
3 species · 120 ac
components.css: .ds-card { background: #152115; border: 1px solid #24382a; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #ecf2ea; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #5b8bab; margin: 0; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Full-width search field. Elevated fill, pine focus border. No glow.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 14px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1a2a1c; color: #ecf2ea; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 14px 14px 14px 40px; border: 1px solid #24382a; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c7260; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4c9a5f; border-width: 1.5px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: 4-tab bottom nav. Forest surface, pine active state, muted inactive.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; background: #111b12; height: 68px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; border-top: 1px solid #1d2f22; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 16px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item span { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #5c7260; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(76,154,95,0.18); } .ds-nav-item--active span { font-weight: 700; color: #4c9a5f; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: FishingSectionHeader — Mud Track label used as a deliberate brand cadence element, not a generic eyebrow.
components.css: .ds-section-header { font-family: 'MudTrack', Georgia, serif; font-size: 13px; color: #9db3a0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Alaska Atlas is the design of a worn, trusted field guide — dense with real information, every detail earned rather than decorated. The background is the deep black-green of a spruce forest at 5am, and everything that appears on it carries weight. This is not a minimal SaaS tool or a consumer travel app. It is reference material that happens to run on a phone.

The palette is built entirely around the land: near-black evergreen surfaces, a single pine-green accent that maps to action and trust, a rust-orange that evokes Turnagain Outfitters' brand heat, a worn birch tan for secondary data, and a water-blue reserved for fishing contexts. Typography pairs Mud Track (a distressed display face with the authority of a carved trail sign) with Bitter (a slab serif that reads like a regulation booklet reborn) and Inter (clean, precise body text). No decoration for its own sake. Every element earns its presence.

The system rejects the two failure modes Alaska Atlas was built to replace: the government-reg site (correct data, visually punishing, no trust-building) and the outdoor-retail app (shopping-first, cross-sell everywhere, no field utility).
keyCharacteristics: Deep forest dark mode — used at dawn in low ambient light
One saturated accent (pine green) on ≤20% of any surface
Mud Track on display headlines only; Bitter and Inter below
Topo-line texture on backgrounds — subtle, never decorative
Cards earn their borders; no nested cards, no side-stripe accents

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Pine (#4C9A5F) is the sole saturated action color. Rust is the Turnagain accent, water is the fishing accent — neither substitutes for pine in navigation or primary interactions. Using two accent colors simultaneously on one screen is prohibited.

rules.name: The Water Reservation Rule
rules.body: Water blue (#5B8BAB) is fishing-context only. It does not appear in Guides, Rentals, or Map except where a fishing-specific element is present.

rules.name: The Mud Track Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Mud Track is reserved for display-level text (20px minimum, 42px maximum) and app bar titles. Anything smaller is Bitter or Inter. Using Mud Track at body or label size destroys its authority.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text must use #ECF2EA or #9DB3A0 on dark surfaces. No grays invented for elegance. Muted text (#5C7260) is permitted only for genuinely tertiary information.

rules.name: The No-Float Rule
rules.body: Shadows do not appear on elements at rest. They appear only on bottom sheets and modal surfaces as structural disambiguation, not as hover delight effects.

dos: Keep Mud Track exclusively at display/AppBar scale (20px+)
Put a border (#24382A) stroke on every card and input field
Use water blue (#5B8BAB) only in fishing-context UI
Default to textSecondary (#9DB3A0) for body content
Apply TopoBackground at 0.3 opacity to every screen
Earn trust through precision — every label and species name verified against source data
donts: Don't use a light or cream background anywhere — this is a field tool used at dawn
Don't make government-reg-style walls of unformatted text
Don't let the Rentals tab feel like REI or Bass Pro
Don't use border-left or any single-side border stripe as a card accent
Don't apply Mud Track below 20px or above 42px
Don't use pine green and rust simultaneously as prominent elements on the same screen
Don't add card elevation shadows on hover/active states
Don't put a side-stripe left border on any callout, alert, or card
